# Subway Seat for Chroma

Chroma styles in the XML format chroma keeps in its styles/ folder, the highlighter behind Hugo, glamour and Gitea.

[Chroma](https://github.com/alecthomas/chroma) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/chroma/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.xml`](subway-seat.xml) | chroma's styles/subway-seat.xml |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.xml`](subway-seat-tunnel.xml) | chroma's styles/subway-seat-tunnel.xml |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.xml`](subway-seat-enamel.xml) | chroma's styles/subway-seat-enamel.xml |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Go code using chroma (Hugo and glamour pick it up by name once it ships in chroma's styles/):

```text
f, _ := os.Open("subway-seat.xml")
style, _ := chroma.NewXMLStyle(f)
styles.Register(style)
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Go code using chroma (Hugo and glamour pick it up by name once it ships in chroma's styles/):

```text
f, _ := os.Open("subway-seat-tunnel.xml")
style, _ := chroma.NewXMLStyle(f)
styles.Register(style)
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Go code using chroma (Hugo and glamour pick it up by name once it ships in chroma's styles/):

```text
f, _ := os.Open("subway-seat-enamel.xml")
style, _ := chroma.NewXMLStyle(f)
styles.Register(style)
```
